description: Night 30 (2026-10-29; Dr. Luitel, 2026-10-21: a pretrained spectrogram classifier or a pretrained model on spectrograms): the Audio Spectrogram Transformer fine-tuned on AudioSet (MIT/ast-finetuned-audioset-10-10-0.4593; sound-event labels, no transcripts), frozen, reading the log-mel spectrogram its own feature extractor makes; each of its 13 layers' mean vector per utterance (over the outputs covering the utterance's samples) with the SVM of night 19c's classical_pretrained_wavlm_large_so3_1, whose settings this sweep keeps except the feature set. Seed 1. How the results are read is fixed in RULE_night30.txt (analyses/night30_prep_20261029) before any run. Runs on CPUs in the classical environment.
